text.tspan: Eight modules across five days. Every day builds on the one before it.
CivicTrack — one 311 service-request system for the City of Rivervale, seen through a new lens every day:
set up its workspace, version-control its documents, model and query its data, write a piece of its logic, then see it whole.
Nothing here assumes you have programmed before. By Friday you will have read, written and run real code.
